title: Automatic Tap Haath Kaise Pehchanta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Washroom ka tap aapka haath dekhta nahi, kuch aur hi sense karta hai! Is video mein dekho andar kya chalta hai.
💡 Myth: tap camera ya body heat se kaam karta hai
🔦 Invisible infrared light ka pulse aur uska reflection
⚙️ Sensor, chip aur valve ka poora chain
🧽 Tap na chale ya band na ho to kya karein
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karein!
